handback.summary: The card now puts each gate's shown name back to its plain name, so the manifest guard sees it again.

criteria.846.1: `dokima/card.py` `render` finds all tests among `plain(check_runs)`, which maps the shown name back to the plain one.
criteria.846.3: `dokima/card.py` `checks_by_key` strips the Acceptance criteria check's shown prefix from criterion names.
criteria.846.4: `dokima/uptodate.py` `tests_failed` asks GitHub for all tests by `settings.shown_as`.
criteria.846.5: `dokima/card.py` `checks_passed` reads all tests from `plain(check_runs)` and criteria by `checks_by_key`.
